content_html:
watched #Vikram : An above average Drug Mafia based movie…elevated by top notch performances by Kamal Hasan, Fahadh Faasil, Vijay Sethupathi and others…and a terrific BGM by Anirudh 🙏🙏🙏 The BGM haunts you even several hours after the movie….If considered as a standalone movie, then its a one time watch, but Lokesh’s vision to expand this universe gives us the small kicks to link with Khaidi and other future parts….hopefully the director fully explores all the chars which are rushed and not properly justified…..

First half is bit confusing and I felt that the movie was over hyped….but the way things unfolded in second half is the brilliance of the director!!!

A Must Watch for fans of Khaidi….
